notes.title: Touhou Nil Soul V1.0.0 updated
notes.content:
[h1]Under a two-year development, Touhou Nil Soul is now official released.[/h1]

Through one year of checking feedbacks from your players, we've adjust the game the best we could. Difficulty is now selectable, and it'll always be easy to just beat the game. The heart of the game however, is the challenge offered by playing higher difficulties. Hope you can try them so long as you can.

Also, the official soundtrack presented as a DLC is now released, if you enjoy our compositions, we welcome your purchase.

After that, besides fixes, Touhou Nil Souls will no longer receives any updates on gameplay. Thanks for all of your long waits and supports!

[b]Contents of today's update are followed:[/b]

[h2]Unlocked[/h2]
[list]
[*]Marisa (Boss)
[*]Flandre (Boss)
[*]Sakuya (Playable)
[*]Flandre (Playable)
[*]Secret Ending - The After Story
[/list]

[h2]New Mechanisms[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bullet pattern is now possible to be altered, in a way of luring bullets toward a certain location.
[*]Picked up items are now possible to be selected to be used on whichever ally.
[*]Several bullets now has knockback properties.
[*]Attacking under a certain buff will gain a chance of inflicting an extra effect on target.
[/list]

[h2]System[/h2]
[list]
[*]Selectable enemy difficulty, ranging from lv0 to lv5. The level of the loot is directly depend on the difficulty.
[*]Free camera is now available, toggle it in the option menu.
[*]Mid-stage minigame is now skippable.
[*]Equipment can now be sold.
[*]Decreases the health loss when moving under Bleeding effect.
[/list]

[h2]Character[/h2]
[list]
[*]Marisa's base speed is decreased to 10.
[/list]

notes.title: 2019.12.30 update,add Izayoi Sakuya and Reimilia Scarlet,and ...
notes.content:
# Version 0.8.8a
- Date：2019/11/30

## Main Update
- Unlocked character: Remilia Scarlet

## Mechanic
- Added environmental buffs.
- Multiple actions in one round is now available.

## System
- Basic Nil-Soul reward of stage raises 95%
- Increase the amount of equipment rewards after battle win

## Character
- Reimu (Enemy).
  - Will prioritize Seal Fantasy and Omnidirectional Oni-Binding Circle in phase 3.

# Version 0.8.7
- Date：2019/11/20

## System
- The odds of item loot of White, Blue, and Yellow rarities were adjusted from [0.4, 0.45, 0.15] to [0.3, 0.45, 0.25], respectively.
- Some armors and accessories now provide speed boost.
- Story Replay is now available.
- Added achievements available on Steam.

## Character
- Reimu (Enemy)
  - Now casts Omnidirectional Oni-Binding Circle.
- Reimu (Allies)
  - New available skill, Omnidirectional Oni-Binding Circle.
- Marisa (Allies)
  - New available skill, Mad Collector.
- Daiyousei (Allies)
  - New available skill, Fairy of the Nature
- Hong Meiling (Allies)
  - New available skill, Rainbow Force.
- Koakuma (Allies)
  - New available skill, Devil's Game.

# Version 0.8.6
- Date：2019/11/5

## Character
- Rumia (Allies)
  - New available skill, Dark Sanctuary.
  - Great Eater: Altered as follows:
    - Old: Consumes 20 mana. Collect up to 2 loots within 2 grids. Each one collected gains 8%+ damage and 2+ range boost. Last for 5 rounds. Can stack up to 6 times.
    - Present: Consumes 15 mana. Collect up to 2 loots within 2 grids. Each one collected gains 12%+ damage and 2+ range boost. Last for 5 rounds. Can stack up to 4 times.
  - Dark Side of Moon: Mana cost decreased by 5, damage increased from 120% to 150%.
  - Moonlight Ray: Mana cost increased by 5,, damage increased from 180% to 210%.
- Daiyousei (Allies)
  - Poison (buff): Health point lost for each round decreased from 8% to 5%, and shield point lost from 4% to 3%.
  - Fairy Healing: Now heals 25% of the target's maximun health instead of 20%.
  - Daiyousei's Assist: Altered as follows:
    - Old: Release an aura within 5x5 range. Affected allies gain 50% life & shield absorption, and 25% damage boost. Lasts for 2 rounds.
    - Present: Release an aura within 5x5 range. Affected allies gain 35% life & shield absorption, and 20% damage boost. Lasts for 2 rounds.
- Hong Meiling (Allies)
 - Tiger's Cry (buff): Now gains Stun and Freeze immune.
 - Dragon Kick: Fix the incorrect damage.
- Hong Meiling (Allies/Enemy)
  - Star Reverse Blast: Each hit now deals 100% damage instead of 90%.

## UI
- Added new UI sound effects.
- Redesigned the icons for skills and status effects, so they're now more visualized.

# Version 0.8.5
- Date：2019/9/30

## Main contents
- New character: Izayoi Sakuya
   - Unlocking the 8th boss Izayoi Sakuya, she is a brutal assassin who can manipulate time

## System
- The life stealing (shield absorption, Reiki absorption) is related to all damage only. Before we fixed: Life stealing is based on damage to HP, and shield absorption is based on damage to shield.
- Some skills can work in two targets.
- Insert a Danmaku that cannot be erased.
- Time
  - Some skills can stop the buff time and not move the Danmku for player operation.
  - Some skills move the Danmaku with every player action.

## text
- “Miss” and “Dodge” were written in English.

# Version 0.8.4
- Date：2019/8/31

## Properties
- Critical chance: Critical is effect on all characters now.
- Attack range
  - Adjust origin number of character's attack range, no more growing numbers.
  - Attack range's extra damage and punishment effects alley and enemy. 
  - adjust the number of damage effected by attack range.
  - Attack range effects accracy, if character over the attack range will get punished by decrease accracy. (only player)
- Accracy: Add accracy systrem, player/enemy (97/100%)
- Dodge: Add dodge sysytem. 

## Text
- “Uptade history” add languages.

# Version 0.8.3
- Date：2019/8/12

## Major Content Update
- New Charactor: Patchouli
  - Unlocked the 7th stage boss fight! Patchouli is a senior spell caster, enormous knowlodge gives her power and abilities to face any situation in magical fights.
- UI
  - Added new icons for spellcards, most of Patchouli's spellcard icons has their own design. This makes spellcard's indentity much clear.
  - In town page, you can roll the page of character's skill states for reading skill.

## Fix
- Fixed a hang up issue during loading, caused by digit number style in some culture.

## Credits
- Thanks to CPT Gadget's help with localization work.

# Version 0.8.2
- Date：2019/7/12

## Major Content Update
- New Charactor: Little Devil
  - Unlocked the 6th stage boss fight! Little Devil is naughty, though low threaten, her fever of explotion may cause a big trouble.
- Text
  - Improve readabilty to battle related text.
  - English: all battle related text (stats, spellcards, battle status) has been re-worked.
- Battle Pace Acceleration 
  - Reduced waiting time on round start.
  - Speed up some characters animation.
  
## New Mechanics
- Danmaku Explosion: Danmaku now can trigger some effects, ex. explotion on hit.
- Life leach for other: Some unit can leach life and heal other units.

## Balance Change
- Rumia
  - Shadow Bolt: now dealing 200% damage (down from 250%).
- Daiyousei (Player)
  - Throw Kunai：now throw 2 (up from 1) each time.

## Spellcard
- Marisa
  - Master Spark: update with a new visual effect.

## Animation
- Hoan Meirin
  - Speed up jump move animation.
  
## Fix
- Fixed the "grey screen" issue caused by cultrue.

- In terms of game content, Cirno is unlocked and can be used as a teammate after defeating her.
  - Cirno can use the battlefield area block skills , which will hinder our movement and lock the props. Obstacles can be eliminated by clearing the curtains, and avoid Danmaku .
- Fighting system
  - Add the crit system, the damage is 1.5 times when the crit occurs, and the damage of the combo class each time the combo damage is calculated separately (such as the Master Spark of Marisa is the continuous damage, the crit is calculated separately for each damage. rate)
  - Added guidance class skills. When the class skills are launched, the initiator must only do this in the launch round, uncontrolled.

[h1]fixed some bugs:[/h1]

Mainly fixed some bugs including ribbons

This update mainly includes the content, I hope everyone can enjoy this game, thank you!

notes.title: Updated 2019.04.01, you can now get B points in battle, BOSS battles have tried to lower the level of difficulty, and other problems have been solved.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34335276/ecc7b08a8e795533a26af622cb1248f6f5c69c44.png[/img]

[b]v0.7.7b[/b]

[h1]Attention[/h1]

Since updating the version may affect the save data you have, it is recommended that you copy your save date at first and then update it.
Save document: C: \ Users \ account name \ App Data \ Local Low \ Epicomic \ Touhou Nil Soul \ Save

It is recommended to save data before updating.

-------------------

This is the first update since it was released on March 22, and we made various adjustments to the game balance. I would like to make a better game experience for you.

[h1]Content Below:[/h1]

1. During the battle, you will be able to get B points, restore your spirituality and indirectly strengthen your allies;
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34335276/da8a93c4806dc4c4b26cecf3c320e4cca9469e3b.png[/img]

2. By reducing BOSS attributes to a certain extent, Reimu on the first stage can be cleared more easily.

[h1]Current test results:[/h1]

1. After having understood the system, Reimu can be cleared to about 15 turns(5 minuts), and Rumiya and the great fairy are about 20 turns.

2. Once the equipment is in place, the LV2BOSS will clean up on the left and right 30turn.

A player has  played so hard and made such great number(can just challenge LV.2 Reimu already
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34335276/91a8c3d50ef1b3669ca7eef3bc7aef8b4531ba91.jpg[/img]

[h1]Further publicize:[/h1]

Each time you unlock a new character, the strength of BOSS increases. It will be the most difficult of four fellows. Therefore, it is this system that the player felt that it became difficult when defeating Rumiya and challenging Reimu again.

[h1]And the bug to be repaired now is:[/h1]

1. The barrier of the equipment does not decrease
2. Equipment duplicates
3. BOSS flying in battle

The testing staff made a BOSS clear video, which can be played back on the BILIBILI video side. Please look forward to it.It could help you play more easier on this game. 

[h1]Future update plan[/h1]
1. critical
2. Unlock of Cirno and Hoan Meilin.

Thank you for your support. Moth
